panels.description: Average heart rate with the lowest and highest sample as a band: per hour for ranges up to 14 days, per day beyond (dash.heart_rate_hourly, dash.heart_days). Workouts show as marked regions (dash.workouts).

defaults.noValue: No heart rate yet. A watch or ring that writes heart rate to Health Connect or Apple Health fills this.

targets.rawSql:
WITH span AS (
  SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= interval '14 days'
         AS hourly
),
hourly AS (
  SELECT g AS time, r.bpm_min, r.bpm, r.bpm_max
  FROM span,
       generate_series(dash.hour_start($__timeFrom()::timestamptz),
                       $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '1 hour') AS g
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT time, bpm_min, bpm, bpm_max FROM dash.heart_rate_hourly
    WHERE install IN (${install:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time)
  ) r ON r.time = g
  WHERE span.hourly
),
daily AS (
  SELECT c.time, r.bpm_min, r.bpm, r.bpm_max
  FROM span,
       dash.days($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) c
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT day, bpm_min, bpm, bpm_max FROM dash.heart_days
    WHERE install IN (${install:sqlstring})
      AND day >= dash.local_day($__timeFrom()::timestamptz)
      AND day <= dash.local_day($__timeTo()::timestamptz)
  ) r ON r.day = c.day
  WHERE NOT span.hourly
),
x AS (SELECT * FROM hourly UNION ALL SELECT * FROM daily)
SELECT time, bpm_min AS "Lowest", bpm AS "Average", bpm_max AS "Highest"
FROM x
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM x WHERE bpm IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Daily median HRV, one line per measure: RMSSD from Android and SDNN from iPhone, never averaged together (dash.measurement_days).

defaults.noValue: No HRV yet. Only some watches write it.

targets.rawSql:

       CASE measure WHEN 'rmssd' THEN 'HRV (RMSSD, Android)' WHEN 'sdnn' THEN 'HRV (SDNN, iPhone)'

       AS metric,
       median AS value
FROM dash.measurement_days

FROM dash.weight_days

ORDER BY time

panels.description: The first reading per day of lean body mass, bone mass and body water mass (dash.measurement_days). Bone and water mass come from Android only.

defaults.noValue: No body composition yet. Some smart scales write it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time,
       CASE type WHEN 'lean_body_mass' THEN 'Lean body mass'
                 WHEN 'bone_mass' THEN 'Bone mass'
                 ELSE 'Body water mass' END AS metric,
       first AS value
FROM dash.measurement_days
WHERE install IN (${install:sqlstring}) AND type IN ('lean_body_mass', 'bone_mass', 'body_water_mass')
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Lean, bone and water mass

panels.description: Body and basal body temperature readings (dash.measurements).

defaults.noValue: No body temperature yet. A thermometer app or an entry in Health Connect or Apple Health fills this.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time,
       CASE type WHEN 'basal_body_temperature' THEN 'Basal body temperature'
                 ELSE 'Body temperature' END AS metric,
       value
FROM dash.measurements
WHERE install IN (${install:sqlstring}) AND type IN ('body_temperature', 'basal_body_temperature')
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time
